shortDescription: Australian businesses are starting to “bubble up” a view that elevated inflation may not fall back below 3%, Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Michele Bullock told a parliamentary panel on Friday, according to Bloomberg.

title: RBA Governor Says Firms Are Questioning Inflation Returning Below 3%
